description: Master index for specs/literature/ content. Used by literature-retrieve.sh for --lit injection into agent prompts. All entries are keyword-indexed for selective retrieval. Book-length files are split into chapter/section subdirectories.

schema.bib_key: BibTeX key in references.bib (null if not yet added)
schema.title: Full title of work
schema.section: Section or chapter description (null for whole-paper files)
schema.page_range: Page range within original source (null if whole paper)

entries.title: Der Minimalkalkül, ein reduzierter intuitionistischer Formalismus
entries.authors: Ingebrigt Johansson
entries.summary: Defines minimal logic by removing ex falso quodlibet from Heyting's intuitionistic system, retaining falsum as a primitive and negation defined as A→⊥.

entries.title: The Completeness of the First-Order Functional Calculus
entries.authors: Leon Henkin
entries.summary: Original Henkin completeness proof for first-order logic using maximal consistent set extension, the method adapted in CSLib for propositional and modal completeness proofs.

entries.title: Verified completeness in Henkin-style for intuitionistic propositional logic
entries.authors: Huayu Guo, Dongheng Chen, Bruno Bentzen
entries.summary: First verified Henkin-style completeness proof for intuitionistic propositional logic following Troelstra and van Dalen's method, implemented in Lean with prime extension lemma.

entries.title: Intuitionistic Propositional Logic in Lean
entries.authors: Dafina Trufas
entries.summary: Formalizes strong completeness for intuitionistic propositional logic in Lean with both Kripke and algebraic semantics, directly comparable to CSLib's approach.

entries.title: SeCaV: A Sequent Calculus Verifier in Isabelle/HOL
entries.authors: Asta Halkjær From, Frederik Krogsdal Jacobsen, Jørgen Villadsen
entries.summary: Formalizes soundness and completeness for sequent calculus in Isabelle/HOL, relevant as comparative prior art for CSLib's proof system.

entries.title: Introduction to a General Theory of Elementary Propositions
entries.authors: Emil L. Post
entries.summary: Proved functional completeness of propositional connectives and introduced truth tables systematically; foundational for CSLib's Evaluate/Tautology definitions.

entries.title: Investigations into Logical Deduction — Synopsis and Notation
entries.authors: Gerhard Gentzen
entries.section: Synopsis and Section I: Terminology and Notation
entries.summary: Synopsis and notation for Gentzen's foundational paper introducing natural deduction (NJ, NK) and sequent calculus (LJ, LK).

entries.title: Investigations into Logical Deduction — Section II: Natural Deduction
entries.authors: Gerhard Gentzen
entries.section: Section II: The Calculus of Natural Deduction
entries.summary: The calculus of natural deduction for both classical (NK) and intuitionist (NJ) predicate logic, with introduction and elimination rules.

entries.title: Investigations into Logical Deduction — Section III: LJ, LK and Hauptsatz
entries.authors: Gerhard Gentzen
entries.section: Section III: The Deductive Calculi LJ, LK and Proof of the Hauptsatz
entries.summary: Introduces LJ and LK sequent calculi and proves the Hauptsatz (cut elimination theorem), the central result of Gentzen's paper.

entries.title: Investigations into Logical Deduction — Section IV: Applications
entries.authors: Gerhard Gentzen
entries.section: Section IV: Some Applications of the Hauptsatz
entries.summary: Applications of the Hauptsatz including consistency proofs, the subformula property, and independence results.

entries.title: Investigations into Logical Deduction — Section V: Equivalence
entries.authors: Gerhard Gentzen
entries.section: Section V: Equivalence of NJ, NK with LJ, LK
entries.summary: Proves that the natural deduction calculi NJ, NK are equivalent to the sequent calculi LJ, LK.

entries.title: A New Introduction to Modal Logic — Preface and Contents
entries.authors: G. E. Hughes, M. J. Cresswell
entries.summary: Preface and TOC for Hughes & Cresswell's introduction to modal logic.

entries.title: A New Introduction to Modal Logic — Part I: Basic Modal Propositional Logic
entries.authors: G. E. Hughes, M. J. Cresswell
entries.section: Part I: Basic Modal Propositional Logic (Ch 1-6, pages 3-130)
entries.summary: Part I covers K, T, D, S4, S5, B modal systems with completeness proofs via canonical models.

entries.title: A New Introduction to Modal Logic — Part II: Normal Modal Systems
entries.authors: G. E. Hughes, M. J. Cresswell
entries.section: Part II: Normal Modal Systems (Ch 7-12, pages 133-230)
entries.summary: Part II covers advanced canonical model techniques, finite model property, and incompleteness results for normal modal systems.

entries.title: A New Introduction to Modal Logic — Part III: Modal Predicate Logic
entries.authors: G. E. Hughes, M. J. Cresswell
entries.section: Part III: Modal Predicate Logic (Ch 13-19, pages 233-408)
entries.summary: Part III covers quantified modal logic including LPC, identity, descriptions, intensional objects, and counterpart theory.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic (6th ed.) — Front Matter
entries.authors: Elliott Mendelson
entries.summary: Front matter for Mendelson's standard mathematical logic textbook (6th edition).

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Chapter 1: The Propositional Calculus
entries.authors: Elliott Mendelson
entries.summary: Chapter 1 develops the propositional calculus with an axiom system, completeness and soundness proofs.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Chapter 2: First-Order Logic
entries.authors: Elliott Mendelson
entries.section: Chapter 2: First-Order Logic and Model Theory (pages 45-152)
entries.summary: First-order logic and model theory, including completeness via Henkin's method and advanced topics like ultraproducts.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Chapter 3: Formal Number Theory
entries.authors: Elliott Mendelson
entries.summary: Formal number theory including Peano arithmetic and Godel's incompleteness theorems.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Chapter 4: Axiomatic Set Theory
entries.authors: Elliott Mendelson
entries.summary: Axiomatic set theory in the NBG system, covering classes, ordinals, and cardinals.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Chapter 5: Computability
entries.authors: Elliott Mendelson
entries.summary: Computability theory including Turing machines, recursive functions, and undecidability results.

entries.title: Modal Logic (CZ) — Front Matter
entries.authors: Alexander Chagrov, Michael Zakharyaschev
entries.summary: Front matter for Chagrov & Zakharyaschev's Modal Logic, the primary CSLib reference (cited as 'CZ').

entries.title: Modal Logic (CZ) — Part I: Introduction
entries.authors: Alexander Chagrov, Michael Zakharyaschev
entries.section: Part I: Introduction — Classical Logic, Intuitionistic Logic, Modal Logics (Ch 1-4)
entries.summary: Part I introduces classical logic, intuitionistic Kripke semantics, modal logic K, and the superintuitionistic/modal classification.

entries.title: Modal Logic (CZ) — Part II: Kripke Semantics
entries.authors: Alexander Chagrov, Michael Zakharyaschev
entries.section: Part II: Kripke Semantics — Canonical Models, Filtration, Incompleteness (Ch 5-6)
entries.summary: Canonical model construction and filtration techniques for proving Kripke completeness of modal and superintuitionistic logics.

entries.title: Modal Logic (CZ) — Part III: Adequate Semantics
entries.authors: Alexander Chagrov, Michael Zakharyaschev
entries.section: Part III: Adequate Semantics — Algebraic and Relational Semantics, Canonical Formulas (Ch 7-9)
entries.summary: Adequate algebraic and relational semantics for modal logics, including descriptive frames and canonical formula characterizations.

entries.title: Modal Logic (CZ) — Part IV: Properties of Logics
entries.authors: Alexander Chagrov, Michael Zakharyaschev
entries.section: Part IV: Properties of Logics — Kripke Completeness, Finite Approximability, etc. (Ch 10-15)
entries.summary: Properties of modal logics: Sahlqvist completeness, finite approximability, tabularity, interpolation, and disjunction property.

entries.title: Modal Logic (CZ) — Part V: Algorithmic Problems
entries.authors: Alexander Chagrov, Michael Zakharyaschev
entries.summary: Algorithmic and complexity problems in modal and superintuitionistic logics.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Front Matter
entries.authors: Alonzo Church

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Introduction
entries.authors: Alonzo Church
entries.summary: Church's introduction covering the logistic method, formal logic, semantic analysis, and historical overview.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Chapter I: The Propositional Calculus
entries.authors: Alonzo Church
entries.summary: Church's treatment of the propositional calculus (system Px), including completeness and consistency.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Chapter II: Propositional Calculus (Continued)
entries.authors: Alonzo Church
entries.section: Chapter II: The Propositional Calculus (Continued, pages 119-179)
entries.summary: Alternative formulations of the propositional calculus, many-valued logics, and modal/intuitionistic extensions.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Chapter III: Functional Calculi of First Order
entries.authors: Alonzo Church
entries.section: Chapter III: Functional Calculi of First Order (pages 180-225)
entries.summary: Introduction to functional calculi of first order with quantifiers and individual variables.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Chapter IV: Pure Functional Calculus of First Order
entries.authors: Alonzo Church
entries.section: Chapter IV: The Pure Functional Calculus of First Order (pages 226-307)
entries.summary: The pure functional calculus of first order with completeness theorem.

entries.title: Introduction to Mathematical Logic — Chapter V: Functional Calculi of Second Order
entries.authors: Alonzo Church
entries.section: Chapter V: Functional Calculi of Second Order (pages 308+)
entries.summary: Second-order functional calculi and the simple theory of types.

entries.title: Advanced Modal Logic — Introduction
entries.authors: Michael Zakharyaschev, Frank Wolter, Alexander Chagrov
entries.summary: Introduction to the Advanced Modal Logic handbook chapter, providing historical overview and roadmap for unimodal, polymodal, and superintuitionistic logic sections.

entries.title: Advanced Modal Logic — Section 1: Unimodal Logics
entries.authors: Michael Zakharyaschev, Frank Wolter, Alexander Chagrov
entries.summary: Comprehensive survey of unimodal normal modal logics including completeness, canonical formulas, and tabularity results.

entries.title: Advanced Modal Logic — Section 2: Polymodal Logics
entries.authors: Michael Zakharyaschev, Frank Wolter, Alexander Chagrov
entries.summary: Polymodal logics including products and fusion constructions relevant to bimodal and temporal logic.

entries.title: Advanced Modal Logic — Section 3: Superintuitionistic Logics
entries.authors: Michael Zakharyaschev, Frank Wolter, Alexander Chagrov
entries.summary: Superintuitionistic logics, their lattice structure, modal companions, and relationship to S4 extensions.

entries.title: Axioms for Tense Logic. I. "Since" and "Until"
entries.authors: John P. Burgess
entries.summary: Axiomatizes the Until-Since tense logic for arbitrary linear orders, dense orders, and discrete orders using maximal consistent set constructions; companion to Burgess 1982 Part II.

entries.title: Axioms for Tense Logic. II. Time Periods
entries.authors: John P. Burgess
entries.summary: Axiomatizes the period-based tense logic for dense linear orders (rationals and reals), introducing the chronicle construction used in CSLib's BX canonical model.

entries.title: Basic Tense Logic
entries.authors: John P. Burgess
entries.summary: Comprehensive handbook chapter on basic tense logic: semantics of F/P/G/H/U/S operators, axiom systems for linear/dense/discrete orders, and canonical model completeness methodology.

entries.title: Temporal Logic: Mathematical Foundations — Chapter 10: Temporal Logic over the Integers
entries.authors: Dov Gabbay, Ian Hodkinson, Mark Reynolds
entries.section: Chapter 10: Temporal Logic over the Integers (pp. 562-640)
entries.summary: Chapter 10 of GHR94: Separation Theorem for temporal logic over integers (Theorem 10.2.9) and completeness proof for the Until-Since tense logic over ℤ; basis for CSLib's bimodal separation proof.

entries.title: Axiomatising First-Order Temporal Logic: Until and Since over Linear Time
entries.authors: Mark Reynolds
entries.summary: Sound and complete axiom system for first-order temporal logic with Until and Since over linear orders; the canonical MCS construction methodology parallels CSLib's chronicle-based completeness proof.

entries.title: Modal Logic — Front Matter and Preface
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.section: Front matter, Table of Contents, and Preface (pages viii-xx)
entries.summary: Front matter, TOC, and preface for Blackburn et al. Modal Logic.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §1.1-1.2 Relational Structures and Modal Languages
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Defines relational structures and modal languages including the basic modal language and its extensions.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §1.3 Models and Frames
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Links modal languages to relational structures via Kripke models and frames.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §1.4-1.8 General Frames through Summary
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: General frames, modal consequence relations, normal modal logics, and historical overview.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §2.1 Invariance Results
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Invariance results for modal logic: generated submodels, disjoint unions, bounded morphisms.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §2.2-2.3 Bisimulations and Finite Models
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Bisimulations, modal equivalence, finite model property via filtration and tree unraveling.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §2.4-2.5 Standard Translation and Modal Saturation
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.section: Chapter 2: §2.4-2.5 Standard Translation and Ultrafilter Extensions
entries.summary: Standard translation to first-order logic and modal saturation via ultrafilter extensions.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §2.6 Characterization and Definability
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Van Benthem characterization theorem: modal logic as the bisimulation-invariant fragment of first-order logic.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §2.7-2.8 Simulation, Safety, and Summary
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Simulation, safety properties, and summary of Chapter 2 on models.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §3.1-3.2 Frame Definability
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Frame definability and its relationship to second-order logic.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §3.3-3.5 Definable Properties, Finite Frames, Correspondence
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.section: Chapter 3: §3.3-3.5 Definable/Undefinable Properties, Finite Frames, Correspondence
entries.summary: Definable and undefinable frame properties, finite frames, and automatic first-order correspondence.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §3.6 Sahlqvist Formulas
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Sahlqvist formulas and the Sahlqvist correspondence/canonicity theorem.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §3.7 More about Sahlqvist Formulas
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Extended Sahlqvist formula theory and inductive formulas.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §3.8-3.9 Advanced Frame Theory and Summary
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.section: Chapter 3: §3.8-3.9 Advanced Frame Theory and Summary
entries.summary: Advanced frame theory and summary of Chapter 3 on frames.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §4.1-4.2 Preliminaries and Canonical Models
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Completeness preliminaries: maximal consistent sets, Lindenbaum lemma, and canonical model construction.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §4.3-4.4 Applications and Limitative Results
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Canonical model completeness for S4, S5, and limitative results on Kripke incompleteness.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §4.5-4.6 Transforming Canonical Model and Step-by-step
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.section: Chapter 4: §4.5-4.6 Transforming Canonical Model and Step-by-step
entries.summary: Techniques for transforming canonical models and step-by-step constructions.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §4.7-4.8 Rules for the Undefinable and Finitary Methods I
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.section: Chapter 4: §4.7-4.8 Rules and Finitary Methods I
entries.summary: Rules for undefinable frame properties and finitary proof methods including tableaux.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §4.9-4.10 Finitary Methods II and Summary
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.section: Chapter 4: §4.9-4.10 Finitary Methods II and Summary
entries.summary: Resolution, translation methods, and summary of Chapter 4 on completeness.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §5.1-5.2 Logic as Algebra
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.section: Chapter 5: §5.1-5.2 Logic as Algebra and Algebraizing Modal Logic
entries.summary: Algebraic approach to modal logic: Boolean algebras with operators and algebraization.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §5.3 Jonsson-Tarski Theorem
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: The Jonsson-Tarski representation theorem connecting modal algebras and relational structures.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §5.4 Duality Theory
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Stone duality between modal algebras and descriptive frames.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §5.5 General Frames
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: General frame theory: refined, compact, and descriptive frames with morphisms.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §5.6-5.7 Persistence and Summary
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Persistence, Sahlqvist canonicity, and summary of Chapter 5 on algebras and general frames.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §6.1-6.3 Satisfiability and Decidability
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Computing satisfiability and decidability via finite models and interpretations.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §6.4-6.5 Quasi-models, Mosaics, and Tiling
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Decidability via quasi-models and mosaics, undecidability via tiling reductions.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §6.6-6.7 NP and PSPACE
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: NP-completeness and PSPACE results for modal satisfiability.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §6.8-6.9 EXPTIME and Summary
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: EXPTIME results for PDL and summary of Chapter 6 on computability and complexity.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §7.1 Logical Modalities
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Logical modalities: global and difference modalities as extensions of the basic modal language.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §7.2-7.3 Since/Until and Hybrid Logic
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.section: Chapter 7: §7.2-7.3 Since and Until, Hybrid Logic
entries.summary: Temporal logic with Since and Until operators, and hybrid logic with nominals.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §7.4 The Guarded Fragment
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: The guarded fragment of first-order logic and its relationship to modal logic.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §7.5 Multi-Dimensional Modal Logic
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.summary: Multi-dimensional modal logics: products, cylindric modal logic, and arrow logic.

entries.title: Modal Logic — §7.6-7.7 Lindstrom Theorem and Summary
entries.authors: Patrick Blackburn, Maarten de Rijke, Yde Venema
entries.section: Chapter 7: §7.6-7.7 Lindstrom Theorem, Summary, and Notes
entries.summary: Lindstrom theorem for modal logic and summary of Chapter 7 on extended modal logics.
